description: This file defines a PHP class named Handling that extends the Controller class within the Opencart system. The class manages the administrative interface for the 'Handling' total extension in OpenCart, including displaying the configuration page, saving settings, and handling user permissions. It includes methods for rendering the extension's configuration page (`index`) and for saving configuration data (`save`).

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: The Handling class manages the admin interface for configuring the Handling total extension in OpenCart, including rendering the configuration form and saving settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Handling total extension, including setting up breadcrumbs, loading language strings, configs, models, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the extension configuration settings. Checks user permission, updates settings via the model, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
